desc: Read the input values for N, K, and the sequence A.
Ideation complete: Determine that $O(\binom{N}{K})$ approach is feasible due to constraint $\binom{N}{K} \le 10^6$.
Implement a recursive backtracking function to iterate through all combinations of size K.
Maintain the current XOR sum during recursion to avoid recomputing.
Prune the search space when it's impossible to select K elements from the remaining elements.
Track and print the maximum XOR sum found.
